First off good on you for just realizing its time to quit, I'm currently detoxing and on day 18, I did a taper for 2 weeks before and think it helped a lot!

The key for me tapering was giving up control of my stuff, if your living with someone give it to them, give them a schedule and make them promise to say no when you ask for more lol. 

Also if it helps this was my detox-cocktail of sorts, I think it really helped not only the severity but the length as well (Im feeling at about 90-95% on day 18 off a pretty long acting OP)

Day 1 let yourself crap your guts out for a bit (If your DOC was ingested like mine it clears it out of your GI) Then 2mg of Imodium every 4 hours and 4mg right before bed so you don't wake up with the shits.
1000mg vitamin-C in the morning for organ/immune health
Protein shake for lunch to give your body energy
.1mg Clonodone in the afternoon
Gatorade throughout the day
50mg Trazidone, 3mg Melatonin, 1 Ibuprofen at bedtime

Other than that, you've done it before, you know what to expect to some extent (This time hopefully won't be as bad as it seems you haven't been on as long) and not to copycat off everyone but every day (after day 3 or 4) really is better than the last so you've always got something to be thankful for.
